fusions.name: Snap of the Trap
fusions.desc: Sprung jaws close on the target for 14 damage, stun it for 1.2 seconds and leave it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunger Let Out
fusions.desc: Opens a cage of rats: 5 leap out at once, spread apart, each biting for 8 damage. Every bite is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Chewed-Through Bars
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung but Empty
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
